title: Backup and restore
intro: Export every event on this account, including original dates, rules, templates, and reminders. Import only adds or overwrites your own events with the same ID; it does not delete existing data. You will see how many will be added or overwritten before anything is written.
confirmBody: This will add {{created}} and overwrite {{updated}} events. Overwritten events are replaced by the backup and cannot be undone.
invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON
invalidBackup: The file is not a valid Timenote backup
